configurations.description: One fixed non-axis rational 6x8 frame, with a parallel column and a zero column. Exact first independent4 assignment for its 256 toy patterns and lex-first completion; no densities.

For all 28 derivative allocations of total order <=2 on six selected factors, exact symbolic factorization over 16 choices for two completion and two residual factors; selected four tail factors remain fixed.
One fixed non-axis six-column N and two registered physical directions: exact first and mixed second derivative of six abstract quadratic jets equals fixed N inverse Leibniz formula.
Symbolic time-power and Young-square identity for fixed R=3/5,T=2/7; exact physical pullback N^-T diag(d_tail,d_completion)N^-1 and toy-frame sum only. No actual body Gamma.

scope: Independent-four-subset aggregate for fixed cutoff rank>=4 patterns only; no actual body32 constants or kernels.
stop_condition: One invocation; stop at first failed assertion or input-pin mismatch, otherwise after four fixed configurations. No rerun or parameter expansion.
